title: Three parts of strategy
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: If you asked ten people in your company what its strategy is, would you get one answer?
I said I split strategy into three: intellectual capital, behavioural, and procedural. A lot of people in companies, if you ask them what the company strategy is, give ten different answers.

A student in telecom said: there is so much long-term planning that you have to go back and revise your strategy, because technology will leapfrog. By the time you get close to the capital expenditures of five or ten years out, the strategy is irrelevant. We could only really plan about a hundred and eighty days out.
I said: adapting your strategy is key. Who has the ability to adapt the strategy in the company?

I said intellectual capital is identifying, evaluating and acting on intangible assets to gain a competitive advantage: using knowledge, experience and expertise systematically when you think strategically. I said I put the definition together from four or five sources.

The behavioural part involves a cognitive process, I said: thinking, knowing, memory, judging and problem solving. To understand a business strategically we have to have an adequate representation of the problem. A lot of times we don't identify the problem because we sugarcoat it.
The procedural part is the process of converting conceptual plans into action, achievable desired outcomes, I said. This is where the manual of operations comes in.
Which of the three is weakest in your company?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write your company's strategy in one sentence.
Ask three people to write theirs, and compare.
Write how you will describe the problem without sugarcoating it.
Write who can adapt the strategy.

check.q: What three parts did I split strategy into?
What did a student in telecom say about long-term plans?
choices: Technology can leapfrog them, so you revise often

check.q: What did I say the procedural part converts?

recap: Know the three parts of strategy. Adapt it. Convert plans into action.
